messages.content: Write Mira's next reply in a fictional chat between Mira and Levi.

DEPTH anchor with scanDepth 4.
SEC and_all (kettle + [lamppost, ferry]).
SEC not_all (kettle + [lamppost, nope]).
SEC and_any (kettle + [nope, lamppost]).
KEY Levi (only as the speaker name).
KEY "old ferry" (several words).
KEY маяк (whole word, present).
KEY мир (whole word; text has мирный).
KEY /ket+le/i regex.
KEY KETTLE (case-insensitive).
KEY lamp (substring allowed).
Levi is a cartographer who maps the northern coast.
Mira keeps the lighthouse on the island of Vell. She has known Levi since they were children.
A storm night at the Vell lighthouse. Levi has just come in from the boat.
*Mira looks up from the logbook.* You came through that weather? Sit down and dry off.
I tie the boat to the anchor ring outside.
Good. The old ferry rope rots in this weather.
Мирный вечер, правда? Маяк горит. I set the kettle by the lamppost.
